jobs.prompt: Root cause already found: tools/watch-server.mjs handleOwner only reads the JSON body for POST /api/owner/actions/{itemId}/decision, so POST .../prepare always passes an empty body to ownerActions.prepare and every decision prepare returns 422 (choice required). Fix in tools/watch-server.mjs: read the JSON body (same 8 KB cap and strict parsing as decision; invalid JSON or non-object -> 400 'invalid-body', never silently {}) for prepare too and pass it to ownerActions.prepare as the request body; keep header-only token, remote-only, 404 outside remote mode and every other rule unchanged. tools/watch-cli.mjs already passes the prepare body through. Then the four end-to-end tests in tests/board-owner-routes.test.mjs must pass as written (a board-safe decision approved end to end; a hand-build request answerable; production listing via ownerItemsFromBoardInbox with board-safe rules; answers applied to journal, hand-build store, tickets, scope refused). Add a test: prepare with invalid JSON body returns 400 invalid-body. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/board-owner-routes.test.mjs tests/board-owner-actions-handlers.test.mjs tests/board-owner-actions-ui.test.mjs tests/board-inbox.test.mjs tests/decision-board-safe.test.mjs tests/watch-s4-contract.test.mjs tests/watch-token-urls.test.mjs tests/watch-server.test.mjs` and report pass counts (must be 0 failures).
